learning_outcomes.text: Prepare, present, and defend a professional exercise in the field of Mechanical Engineering, applying the acquired competencies.
Communicate clearly and efficiently in oral and written presentations on complex topics, adapting to the situation, the audience type, and communication objectives.
Recognize the knowledge and methods from various disciplines that need to be applied and combined for the best resolution of a given problem.
Identify the need for continuous learning and develop one's own strategy to carry it out.
Decompose a complex task into sub-tasks and plan their execution working autonomously.
Use the necessary information to develop an academic project or work, and be able to select and organize it appropriately after critical reflection.

Capacity for writing, signing, and developing projects in the field of industrial engineering aimed at the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly, or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing and automation processes.
Capacity for directing activities that are the object of Engineering projects.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Capacity to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge for performing measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans, and other similar tasks.
Capacity for handling mandatory specifications, regulations, and standards.
Capacity to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Capacity to apply quality principles and methods.
Capacity for organization and planning in business, and other institutions and organizations.
Capacity to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding, and capacity to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the Industrial Technical Engineer profession.

Original exercise to be carried out individually and presented and defended before a university tribunal, consisting of a project in the field of specific technologies of Industrial Engineering of a professional nature in which the competencies acquired in the teachings are synthesized and integrated.

teaching_methods: Preparation of the Final Degree Project report
Public defense of the exercise before a tribunal
Bibliographic review of the Final Degree Project topic
Execution of the work through the resolution of the proposed objective in the Final Degree Project
Performance of experimental lab work (if necessary and required by the Final Degree Project)
Individual work: Writing of the Final Degree Project report
Individual work: Execution of the main body of the work (theoretical, experimental, design and engineering, etc.)
Individual work: Collection and analysis of documentation, reports, manuals, bibliographic review, etc.

assessment_methods.method: Public defense of the Final Degree Project
Scientific and technical quality of the FDP submitted
Capacity for debate and argumentative defense

assessment_rules: The global grade will take into account the scientific and technical quality of the FDP, the quality of the submitted material, expository clarity, and the capacity for debate and argumentative defense, as well as the tutor's opinion. The final grade will be the arithmetic mean of the grades given by each member of the Evaluation Committee, following a numerical scale from 0 to 10. A pass requires a minimum of 5.0. Students have two opportunities to present and defend their FDP per academic year.
